name: io.github.NiL4gh/storecraft-studio
title: StoreCraft Studio
description: Turns JSON configs into high-res design assets (banners, social posts, marketplace screenshots) via Canvas 2D. Deterministic, no API keys.

tools.name: list_presets
tools.description: List all available design presets (sizes/platforms): Marketplace, Chrome Web Store, Social Media, OpenGraph, Banners, Presentations.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: List all available color themes (8 curated palettes).

tools.name: render_design
tools.description: Render a design from a JSON config (preset, theme, layout, headline, subtitle, badges, callouts) to a high-res PNG file via Playwright + Canvas 2D.

tools.name: save_template
tools.description: Save a design config as a reusable JSON template.

tools.name: load_template
tools.description: Load a previously saved JSON template by name.
